name: laminar
description: Trace Claude Code sessions in Laminar: conversational turns, LLM calls, tool executions, and subagents.

LMNR_PROJECT_API_KEY.description: Laminar project API key (create one in your project settings at https://www.lmnr.ai)

LMNR_BASE_URL.description: Laminar base URL. Keep the default for Laminar Cloud; for self-hosted use e.g. http://localhost:8000

CC_LMNR_USER_ID.description: Optional user id to associate with traces

CC_LMNR_DEBUG.description: Set to 'true' to write debug logs to ~/.claude/state/lmnr_hook.log

CC_LMNR_MAX_CHARS.description: Max characters kept per captured text field before truncation
